circuit_role: Fix the target and all universal quantifiers.
publisher_statement_or_check: HC_m over every field, and PERM_m outside characteristic two, require size greater than m^(c(log₂ m)^(1/3)).
review_finding: The coefficient c precedes the characteristic p; the eventual threshold can depend on p. The target is a formal polynomial.
independent_evidence_scope: Source and wrapper correspondence checked in passes 1, 4 and 11D.
remaining_obligation: Finish both branch proofs and the independent global build before upgrading the overall conclusion.
review_detail: HC sums one-cycle permutations and PERM sums all permutations of an m-by-m matrix. The review concerns exact computation.

circuit_role: Define which candidate circuits every branch must cover.
publisher_statement_or_check: Size counts a straight-line list of variables, field constants, sums and products, with earlier gates reusable.
review_finding: The formal predicate permits arbitrary reuse, cancellation, field-dependent constants and an output at any gate below the size bound.
independent_evidence_scope: Definition and source correspondence reviewed.
remaining_obligation: Check semantic correspondence again when auditing each remaining reduction; successful examples cannot discharge the universal claim.
review_detail: Each circuit may depend on m. Evaluation on all points of a finite field would be weaker than equality of formal polynomials.

circuit_role: Convert wire exponents and cut decompositions into spectral upper bounds.
publisher_statement_or_check: A spectral point values a binary wire by 2 to its distance exponent; the hub construction routes cut terms through auxiliaries.
review_finding: The hub bound is used twice on the same tensor in B.3 and for each summand's own cut in the flat branch.
independent_evidence_scope: Interfaces traced; relevant source modules compiled among earlier dependencies.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the full routing maps, including repeated or degenerate labels, independently of the formal proof.
review_detail: The exponent identity translates tensor inequalities into distance inequalities while the hub construction implements the bipartite factorization.

circuit_role: Select one spectral point that retains all required comparisons.
publisher_statement_or_check: A spectral point below a gauge keeps every triple that the gauge keeps for every multiplier.
review_finding: Zorn minimality, the radius and localization give exact multiplicativity for the same witness; zero factors need a separate case.
independent_evidence_scope: Independent reconstruction; pass-10 build and pass-11B theorem readback; two weakening counterexamples.
remaining_obligation: Any use requiring effective or unique selection would need a further theorem. A.5 supplies existence.
review_detail: An arbitrary infimum can fail submultiplicativity. Testing a triple only at the unit can miss a violating multiplier.

circuit_role: Produce asymptotic tensor covers behind the contracting laws.
publisher_statement_or_check: Comparison at every spectral point implies covers of high powers by at most 2^(εN) products of N factors.
review_finding: A.5 gives one point satisfying every certificate comparison; the detecting index may depend on that point.
independent_evidence_scope: Selection subargument reconstructed. The full Gauges module compiled in pass 10.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the certificate exchange, replacement and terminal multiplicity estimates as a complete mathematical proof.
review_detail: This is a bridge to section G. Existence of a spectral point alone provides no quantitative cover.

circuit_role: Extend a spectral witness for the price and flat-branch constructions.
publisher_statement_or_check: One extended spectral point respects the geometric-mean bound on every tensor and is exact on one designated old tensor.
review_finding: The intermediate gauge agrees on every old tensor. Localization and A.5 force equality at the designated tensor of the selected point.
independent_evidence_scope: Passes 10 and 11B reconstructed the selection; pass 10 rebuilt the complete target module and queried the theorem.
remaining_obligation: Identify the particular positive product at each caller that needs several old observables preserved.
review_detail: For zero spectral value, nonnegativity and domination suffice. A single preserved value need not determine the entire old point.

circuit_role: Add all fan and midpoint labels to one price.
publisher_statement_or_check: One extended price keeps every old distance and upper-bounds every pair by the expectation under a joint random map.
review_finding: Preserving the product of all old wires and coordinatewise domination forces equality for each old wire. Common compact limits retain all inequalities.
independent_evidence_scope: Independent source reconstruction, finite controls, and complete Paper.Prices replay in pass 10.
remaining_obligation: A use with infinite-valued label maps would require additional hypotheses beyond the stated measurable finite-image setting.
review_detail: The two coordinates in one expectation use the same random outcome. New distances may lie strictly below the expectation.

circuit_role: Bound the number of states in the two-wire decomposition.
publisher_statement_or_check: One positive κ upper-bounds log P(E) by κ√E for every E and gives the matching asymptotic lower rate.
review_finding: B.3 uses the uniform upper bound even at bounded coefficient indices; the lower rate is invoked on large source energies.
independent_evidence_scope: All-energy lemma used at its interface in 11A; source and finite example inspected; Paper.States compiled in pass 9.
remaining_obligation: Independently derive the counting asymptotic and its common coefficient from the state combinatorics.
review_detail: A lower asymptotic evaluated at a potentially zero coefficient index would be invalid. The reconstruction tracks the two uses separately.

circuit_role: Provide one integral family for both cut routings.
publisher_statement_or_check: The crossing identity decomposes two matching wires into coefficient tensors with complementary cut complexities.
review_finding: Reflection relates the two degrees in the same integral coefficient family, so scalar extension to a field preserves the identity.
independent_evidence_scope: 11A reconstructed the determinant argument through its intermediate identities and checked a finite class; exact source compiled in pass 9.
remaining_obligation: Independently derive the block-factorization, minor signs and equal-size state restrictions in full generality.
review_detail: This is a tensor identity. The later numbered inequality (B.2) is a separate statement.

circuit_role: Obtain two compatible bounds for one price table.
publisher_statement_or_check: There exist joint nonnegative hub weights in a squared budget that bound both routings.
review_finding: Selecting one large spectral summand supplies the same index for degree and complementary degree. Uniform counting errors and compactness preserve one feasible pair.
independent_evidence_scope: Reconstructed and stress-tested in 11A; Paper.Crossing compiled in pass 9.
remaining_obligation: The independent derivation continues to use B.1, the general B.2 block identities and A.3 routing.
review_detail: Separate maximizers can violate the joint budget. The transfer to a general price approximates all eight labels at once.

circuit_role: Pass the crossing bound into C.2 in a scalar form.
publisher_statement_or_check: Adding the joint inequalities and applying two quadratic estimates eliminates both auxiliary weights.
review_finding: The derivation works pointwise with variable local wire distances as weights before translation averaging.
independent_evidence_scope: 11A independent algebra and eight-point metric counterexample; formal implication compiled in pass 9.
remaining_obligation: Maintain the simultaneous squared budget and a fixed positive Young parameter whenever taking the mean.
review_detail: A bound optimized separately for each cut would not imply this scalar display.

circuit_role: Turn two-dimensional price averages into a parallelogram law.
publisher_statement_or_check: The homogenized mean seminorm obeys the parallelogram equality.
review_finding: The numbered crossing display passes to the root-mean-square length and then to its homogeneous limit. The upper parallelogram inequality alone suffices at C.1's endpoint.
independent_evidence_scope: Source reconstruction, pass-9 full dependency replay with direct axiom readback, and 11A caller audit.
remaining_obligation: For independent human coverage of the entire route, finish the remaining B.1/B.2 and routing obligations.
review_detail: The bound on fixed displacements controls all mean terms. Individual fans need not converge ordinarily.

circuit_role: Establish the midpoint curvature inequality used by the geometry.
publisher_statement_or_check: A midpoint m on an endpoint pair at distance 2D satisfies the CN inequality for every test point z.
review_finding: First A→∞ at fixed T removes the intercept; then the error is at most (6D²+6Db+b²)/T for b=d(z,m).
independent_evidence_scope: Independent endpoint derivation, exact boundary checks, and a fresh 44-module replay of Paper.Fan in pass 9.
remaining_obligation: Preserve the midpoint hypotheses and the order of limiting arguments in downstream interpretations.
review_detail: The coefficient is uniform in T for fixed points. The intermediate seminorm may depend on T.

circuit_role: Realize every price inside one complete CAT(0) price space.
publisher_statement_or_check: Adding compatible midpoints, identifying zero distances and completing realizes the old table as a metric pullback.
review_finding: The Cauchy estimate supplies one limiting midpoint for all test points and the compact price conditions persist on finite tables.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 8 independently derived completion and replayed two unchanged publisher lemmas under narrower imports. A.8 and C.1 were subsequently rebuilt.
remaining_obligation: Replay the entire Paper.Curvature module and trace its price-gluing construction end to end.
review_detail: The method allows distinct original labels to map to one point.

circuit_role: Supply quadrangle, rectangle and projection facts to the field split and flat argument.
publisher_statement_or_check: The CAT(0) toolkit deduces geometric estimates from CN, including equality constraints for flat quadrangles.
review_finding: Passes 7–8 located the exact equality and realization facts that D.2 needs.
independent_evidence_scope: Dependency traced; selected uses reviewed.
remaining_obligation: Independently reconstruct the necessary toolkit cases and complete their source-module replay.
review_detail: A weak diagonal-sum bound alone does not recover the equality structure used in the field alternative.

circuit_role: Ensure at least one branch applies to each field.
publisher_statement_or_check: For a field K either its prices satisfy the contracting condition or every finite Euclidean distance table is a K-price.
review_finding: Failure of contraction produces an extremal price; equality on transversal quadrangles and a cube construction give one table per configuration.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 7 reconstructed eight steps conditionally, tested metric shortcuts and checked two focused reflection lemmas.
remaining_obligation: Complete a fresh Paper.Alternative replay and independently discharge the CAT(0) and finite-geometry inputs.
review_detail: Exhaustion is sufficient; disjointness of the two conditions is unnecessary.

circuit_role: Connect the target circuit to the flat branch's auxiliary polynomial.
publisher_statement_or_check: A permanent circuit at sufficient size parameter gives one for the network polynomial through affine substitution.
review_finding: The reduction retains arbitrary input circuits and supports the printed-variable encoding; the PERM route uses 2≠0.
independent_evidence_scope: Call traced in passes 1–4; size-preserving change of variable encoding checked against the source.
remaining_obligation: Audit every grid gadget and affine substitution including padding, then replay the full flat reduction.
review_detail: M.2 supplies the all-characteristic HC route separately.

circuit_role: Bring an arbitrary circuit, with gate reuse and cancellations, into the flat argument.
publisher_statement_or_check: The block-multilinear component is a sum over balanced subsets with at most L simple products per subset for an L-gate circuit.
review_finding: Collecting by gate and balanced subset permits different cuts in different terms; the same circuit is the input throughout.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 2 reconstructed the gate-level mechanism and tested the single-cut shortcut with an identity minor.
remaining_obligation: Complete a local replay of the flat circuit decomposition and verify remaining gadget assumptions.
review_detail: Bounding rank across one shared flattening would exclude valid decompositions.

circuit_role: Pay for combining the differently cut terms.
publisher_statement_or_check: For J permitted summands, the spectral value is bounded by J to the old-party exponent times the largest summand value.
review_finding: The hub construction supplies the required type of contractions. The number of possible balanced cuts contributes a real exponent cost.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 2 inspected the caller and calculated the cost; source correspondence checked.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the full few-term spectral inequality, including its border-sum implementation.
review_detail: The selector may depend on the circuit. The spectral bound applies to all candidate cut labels.

circuit_role: Control the exponent of a midpoint configuration for a fixed base spectral point.
publisher_statement_or_check: A sufficiently accurate scaled Euclidean approximation gives approximate midpoint convexity of the party exponent.
review_finding: A.7 keeps a positive product of all old wires and a moved unit; C.1 controls the new midpoint. The tolerance is selected before the maps.
independent_evidence_scope: 11B traced the extension and uniform quantifiers; A.7 and C.1 are locally replayed inputs.
remaining_obligation: Complete an independent derivation and local replay of the entire convexity module.
review_detail: Auxiliary extensions may vary by map while estimates return to the same base point.

circuit_role: Find a single spectral witness for the competing flat cuts.
publisher_statement_or_check: In the flat case a spectral point and scale approximate all distances of the finite configuration and bound its facet-centre exponent.
review_finding: The enlarged configuration and one base point/scale are fixed before the cube induction; the bound pays for the cut-label cost.
independent_evidence_scope: Passes 2 and 11B traced the existential and universal orders and use in E.10.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the full cube induction and replay its module, including the approximation parameters.

circuit_role: Lower-bound every circuit for the flat auxiliary polynomial.
publisher_statement_or_check: For k≥2 and ℓ≥100√k the stated bound gives log₂ L at least ℓk^(3/2)/16.
review_finding: The price of each admissible cut and the cost of summing over cuts leave the claimed margin; the reviewed calculation yielded denominator 14.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 2 reconstructed the finite numerical estimates conditionally; pass 4 traced printed-variable correspondence.
remaining_obligation: Rebuild the complete target and discharge upstream flat, decomposition and spectral assertions in one chain.

circuit_role: Translate the flat auxiliary lower bound to large permanent instances.
publisher_statement_or_check: In characteristic other than two, the flat hypothesis implies an eventual permanent lower bound exponential in (log₂ m)^(4/3).
review_finding: The k=r² and ℓ≈100r scaling converts the gate estimate to the stated exponent; the substitution covers sufficiently large m.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 2 checked the asymptotic arithmetic and formal caller; M.3 later applies the branch on an algebraic closure.
remaining_obligation: Replay the complete rate theorem together with its grid substitutions and padding.
review_detail: The transfer to HC and characteristic two proceeds via the separate grid-completeness route.

circuit_role: Convert contraction of matrix prices into geometric input for routing.
publisher_statement_or_check: A Poincaré inequality controls averages for the group action used by the contracting construction.
review_finding: The dependency from the field hypothesis to the laws was located; the group/window estimates remain unreviewed as a full proof.
independent_evidence_scope: Source interface identified; independent mathematical reconstruction open.
remaining_obligation: Prove the growth, near-angle and overlapping-window estimates with the same parameters as the law caller.
review_detail: This is a load-bearing upstream gap for the contracting branch even after checking J.2's local regrouping.

circuit_role: Supply the algebraic laws that allow the contracting cut.
publisher_statement_or_check: The contracting hypothesis yields suitable laws over a finitely generated coefficient subring.
review_finding: The cutting argument assumes these laws; A.6 provides a spectral-duality route to covers.
independent_evidence_scope: Source dependency and A.6 selection subargument traced; the general law construction remains open in this review.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the wire identities, coefficient support, gain and all parameters required by H and J.
review_detail: A small packet example cannot validate the existence of the laws for every required scale.

circuit_role: Transform computation networks into sums of thin-tree outcomes.
publisher_statement_or_check: The tower and tree results give a bounded-outcome transformation with controlled incident load.
review_finding: J.2 only uses the good outcomes inside the finite bounded sum. A reverse implication from goodness to attainability is unnecessary.
independent_evidence_scope: Passes 4, 6 and 11C traced the interface and the boundary charge; full derivation open.
remaining_obligation: Audit the tower construction, variable-length laws, exceptional cases and tree-load estimates end to end.
review_detail: The tower construction begins in Paper/Tower.lean at prop_tower. The bounded outcome domain is part of the later exact identity.

circuit_role: Provide a universal weighted evaluator for plain program inputs.
publisher_statement_or_check: The automaton produces the same total accepting weight within a quasi-linear simulation budget.
review_finding: The pointer encoding preserves each surviving trace's weight and multiplicity. Zero-weight branches can disappear; the final matrix stage preserves the scalar.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 5 compared actual source semantics, checked finite traces in small rings and replayed focused Lean examples/arithmetic.
remaining_obligation: Replay the full Paper.Universal proof and independently account for sorting and address-width costs across all inputs.
review_detail: An unqualified accepting-run bijection on p. 50 is too strong. The downstream J.3 and K.3 calls need the scalar and admitted time bound.

circuit_role: Express the automaton value as a tensor network that can be cut.
publisher_statement_or_check: Boundary states and packet counts expand the bounded automaton contraction.
review_finding: A count vector beyond the incident bound contributes zero through a local table factor, so it can be removed before the tree law.
independent_evidence_scope: Interface and zero-factor argument traced in 11C.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the full run-to-network equality and its bit/work accounting independently.
review_detail: Only after filtering valid counts do the H.2 and J.2 outcome and partition bounds apply.

circuit_role: Factor a bounded good outcome into smaller weighted pieces.
publisher_statement_or_check: One shared boundary value per current cut packet factors the weighted sum; each piece has controlled cut bits, total bits and size.
review_finding: Restriction and gluing are inverse assignments. A single boundary node charges all cut edges of a piece; copies, padding and given work require further charges.
independent_evidence_scope: 11C reconstructed regrouping and boundary charging with exact counterexamples. Fresh targeted replays covered Nc.Cut.Groups (two modules) and Paper.Heavy (four modules).
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the full tower and law expansion and replay Paper.Pieces as a whole.
review_detail: The network is the evaluator's transformed network. The source circuit is allowed arbitrary wiring.

circuit_role: Turn the J.2 factorization into a one-cut program for the accelerator.
publisher_statement_or_check: The program's weighted value is the sum of products of its piece values with time and size controls.
review_finding: The evaluator may omit an empty active-cut packet because its summand has a zero local factor. The bounded outcome domain suffices.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 6 source reconstruction and finite perturbation checks; pass 11C strengthened the J.2 input.
remaining_obligation: Audit the actual listing/evaluation implementation and complete full-module replay with the same input bounds.
review_detail: The local packet checks support weighted-value equality, not equality of all guessed-run counts.

circuit_role: Preserve the value and resource bounds under repeated cuts.
publisher_statement_or_check: Iterated one-cut yields the cutting hypothesis on the permitted instances and scales.
review_finding: Parentheses, rounding, stopping and listing costs are charged as cuts compose. The caller supplies the cut hypothesis used by K.6.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 6 reconstructed the iteration at the stated interfaces and checked selected arithmetic.
remaining_obligation: Replay the full cut implementation and independently connect the upstream tower laws to every setting.
review_detail: The number, time and maximum size of the pieces must hold together for the same original program instance.

circuit_role: Force an arbitrary small circuit into the contracting model.
publisher_statement_or_check: A circuit for the auxiliary polynomial yields a nondeterministic weighted evaluator for its low-degree part.
review_finding: Homogeneous expansion allows gate reuse and cancellation. Named circuit-dependent constants carry coefficients; weights sum over accepting runs.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 3 reconstructed the gate-to-program interface and tested shared-gate multiplicity.
remaining_obligation: Audit the full compiler and its degree, accepting-time and description-size bounds at the implementation level.
review_detail: This is a nonuniform weighted program with a per-accepting-run time bound. An ordinary deterministic Boolean evaluator would be a different claim.

circuit_role: Turn a hypothesized target circuit into an accelerator on plain instances.
publisher_statement_or_check: Circuit evaluation of an encoding polynomial reproduces the universal weighted value for bounded short words.
review_finding: The end marker prevents shorter prefixes from contributing and its degree is included. I.1 supplies a common simulation length at eligible scales.
independent_evidence_scope: Passes 3–5 traced the transfer, formal word-domain guarantees and time arithmetic.
remaining_obligation: Audit the full polynomial construction and equivalence to the displayed word sum where a stronger correspondence is asserted.
review_detail: The downstream interface requires the degree bound, promised evaluation and circuit transfer rather than equality of all internal path counts.

circuit_role: Allow repeated cuts to manipulate named constants within the plainness promise.
publisher_statement_or_check: The postponement transformation separates recording of named constants from the relevant program-evaluation phase.
review_finding: The role of converting program behavior at this interface was located; a full proof of the transformation has not been reconstructed.
independent_evidence_scope: Source interface identified.
remaining_obligation: Check each run, the timing of its output tally, and the overhead for arbitrary programs.
review_detail: The identity concerns weights under the stated hypotheses. Uniform halting and the conditional value guarantee must remain distinct.

circuit_role: Propagate a hypothetical accelerator to the next scale.
publisher_statement_or_check: Cutting plus the previous accelerator yields a faster evaluator under a fixed system of size and exponent bounds.
review_finding: The number of pieces times work per piece and the separate listing cost fit the next budget once the scale condition absorbs fixed factors.
independent_evidence_scope: Passes 3 and 6 reconstructed the rate calculation at the stated interfaces.
remaining_obligation: Replay the recursive program construction, including a uniform check of the required cut, scale and encoding bounds.
review_detail: Arithmetic for one round needs the same instance to satisfy the J.4 listing, length and value promises.

circuit_role: Rule out the accelerator implied by a small circuit.
publisher_statement_or_check: With the cutting hypothesis and a finitely generated coefficient algebra, a diagonal program contradicts an accelerator at sufficiently large scales.
review_finding: Passing to a finite residue field precedes choosing the final scale. Uniform halting allows plainness before the conditional scalar guarantee produces V=1+V.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 3 checked ordering of quantifiers and explicit call of the cutting hypothesis; pass 6 traced its construction.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the full bounded self-input construction, tally transport and machine-level time bookkeeping.
review_detail: The contradiction uses nonzero unit in the specialized field. A value promise conditioned on plainness cannot establish its own premise.

circuit_role: Convert nonexistence of accelerators into a size lower bound in the contracting case.
publisher_statement_or_check: Every permanent circuit in the contracting case outside characteristic two obeys an eventual bound of order 2^(c(log₂ m)²/log₂ log₂ m); the complete-family variant supports HC.
review_finding: The scale can meet the K.3 and K.6 conditions for a sufficiently small fixed branch coefficient; field thresholds are handled later.
independent_evidence_scope: Pass 3 reconstructed the asymptotic comparison and traced the formal contradiction.
remaining_obligation: Discharge the law, program and diagonal dependencies, then replay the full contracting-rate theorem.
review_detail: The exponent eventually dominates a fixed multiple of (log₂ m)^(4/3) even if the comparison begins at a characteristic-dependent threshold.

circuit_role: Transfer any violating circuit without increasing its gate count.
publisher_statement_or_check: An integer-coefficient target with a size-s circuit over F also has one over an algebraically closed K of the same characteristic.
review_finding: Only the finitely generated algebra of the circuit's constants is specialized. Addition, multiplication and the target identity survive gatewise.
independent_evidence_scope: 11D independently reconstructed descent. A fresh 12-module Paper.Transfer replay queried the common-ring, specialization and M.1 declarations and checked one new F₂ obstruction.
remaining_obligation: Use this same-size result with each branch threshold and the exact target's coefficient-map identities; the entire M.3 module has separate replay status.
review_detail: Direct specialization to the prime field can fail, as the polynomial x²+x+1 over F₂ illustrates. No embedding of all of F is required.

circuit_role: Give HC the grid-completeness substitution in every characteristic.
publisher_statement_or_check: A grid sum is represented by a Hamiltonian-cycle projection with the stated size overhead.
review_finding: M.3 calls the HC-completeness route with grid factor 40; the observed formal statement is over a commutative ring.
independent_evidence_scope: Dependency and field scope traced in 11D; independent cycle correspondence still open.
remaining_obligation: Reconstruct the assignment-to-cycle bijection, repeated variables, padding and characteristic-two behavior; replay its module.
review_detail: M.1 cannot supply this reduction. An unexamined multiplicity could change a coefficient in positive characteristic.

circuit_role: Assemble the absolute lower-bound exponent and characteristic-dependent threshold.
publisher_statement_or_check: For one absolute c and each characteristic p there is m₀(p) working for every field of characteristic p and every candidate circuit.
review_finding: Fix one algebraic closure per p, apply the field alternative there, take common target cutoffs and use M.1 to exclude violations over every such F.
independent_evidence_scope: 11D independent quantifier and rate reconstruction; field-level callers traced.
remaining_obligation: Replay Paper.Fields and verify both branch bounds and the HC/permanent substitutions on their prescribed domains.

circuit_role: Deduce the class separation from one explicit family.
publisher_statement_or_check: HC is in VNP over every field and, by M.3, exceeds every polynomial-size VP bound there.
review_finding: The class inclusion, membership lemma, all-fields bound and eventual domination appear in the formal caller in the required order.
independent_evidence_scope: Formal assembly traced; neither a full local separation proof nor independent review of the complete HC-membership construction is claimed.
remaining_obligation: Verify HC membership in the released class encoding, both branch lower bounds and the complete independent separation build.
review_detail: This is arithmetic VP versus VNP for formal families. It does not yield Boolean P versus NP.

circuit_role: Validate all publisher proof modules and public solution wrappers at the source pin.
publisher_statement_or_check: The publisher workflow builds the pinned project and treats placeholders outside the designated challenge files as failures.
review_finding: The public job recorded a successful build; local replays cover named subsets, including the complete C.1 and A.7/A.8 dependency closures.

remaining_obligation: Rebuild the entire package at the locked versions, archive the result, and inspect all exact-theorem wrappers.

publisher_statement_or_check: The configured checker compares five declared targets with a specified axiom policy; the workflow invokes the publisher comparator script.
review_finding: The pinned configuration lists the exact and approximate targets, three allowed axioms and the additional kernel check. The public job reports success.
independent_evidence_scope: Configuration and publisher job metadata inspected. No independent local Comparator run recorded.
remaining_obligation: Run the pinned checker on a clean complete build, retain the per-target logs, and separately check model correspondence.
